results.diagnostic: AIP draft-01 deliberately has no presenter proof-of-possession check; the valid bearer chain cannot be promoted into live-presenter authentication.
non_claims: The presenter is authenticated as aip:key:agent-a.
AIP failed merely because it accurately declared this limitation.
results.permitted_conclusion: The bearer has a valid chain; AIP alone does not establish that the live presenter is the leaf subject.
results.title: Wrong Presenter

results.diagnostic: The signer is authenticated, but draft-01 supplies no organizational control-domain independence rule or constrained result.
non_claims: Different signing keys make the verifier independent.
A Level 2 or Level 3 label proves control-domain separation.
results.permitted_conclusion: A named verifier signed the block; AIP draft-01 does not establish organizational independence.
results.title: Same-Control Verifier

results.diagnostic: The artifact is intact, but unreachable or stale evidence is unverifiable, not rejected; no adjacent signature success repairs that missing appraisal.
non_claims: Unverifiable evidence was rejected on its merits.
A peer_verified label proves the evidence check succeeded.
A valid completion signature proves the claimed execution occurred correctly.
results.permitted_conclusion: The signed completion and result hash are intact, but the underlying evidence could not be established as current or checkable.
results.title: Stale/Unverifiable Completion

results.diagnostic: The AIP Simple-profile tool check succeeds, while the reused Border argument-digest comparison detects a different payload. Tool scope is not promoted into exact-action authorization.
non_claims: A valid AIP chain proves the exact cross-protocol payload was authorized.
A matching tool name makes different arguments the same action.
results.permitted_conclusion: The tool remains in AIP scope, but AIP draft-01 does not establish that the observed MCP arguments are the exact payload authorized by the A2A task.
results.title: A2A to MCP Action Swap

source_byte_verification.policy: all pinned sources must be locally supplied and valid once verification is requested
